title: Sikkim
subtitle: Gangtok in the rain, prayer flags beside Tsomgo Lake, snow at Nathu La and the river road home.
location: Gangtok · Tsomgo Lake · Nathu La · Teesta Valley

cover.alt: Bright prayer flags above still lake water and snow-streaked mountains beneath low cloud.
cover.caption: Bright prayer flags above still lake water and snow-streaked mountains beneath low cloud.

chapters.title: The road into the hills
paragraphs: The journey follows the river into forested hills, past small shops, colourful buildings and a roadside temple.

paragraphs: Buildings climb the hillside beneath an overcast evening sky.

chapters.title: Up through the mountain cloud
chapters.location: Gangtok · road to Tsomgo and Nathu La
paragraphs: Morning clouds drift past the buildings. Higher along the road are prayer flags, a small cafe and dogs beside the mountain settlement.

paragraphs: Hot noodles, hanging bells and red-roofed buildings mark a stop at the shrine before the return past snow-lined walkways.

chapters.title: Along Tsomgo Lake
paragraphs: Snow streaks the slopes above the dark water. Yaks wait beside the lakeside path and prayer wheels line a yellow wall.

chapters.title: Above the lake
paragraphs: The cable car climbs through low cloud, opening views of the lake, its small settlement and the roads winding through the valley.

chapters.title: Back through the river valley
paragraphs: Forested hills and low cloud follow the road down. On the stony riverbank, inflatable rafts wait beside the water.
